correctness.rationale: PASS: The conditional common-clock no-hit probability U=product of q0(reset gaps) makes the three hits a Bernoulli mixture, while independent clocks give h(1-E U). f0(t)=erfc(d/sqrt(4Dt)) has strictly positive second derivative for 0<t<d^2/(6D), so for any common-clock partition 0<1-U<=f0(t)<1/2; strict convexity of h(p)=3p^2-2p^3 gives the early inequality. Joint-survival renewal S_j(t)=exp(-rt)q0(t)^j + (r exp(-r.)q0(.)^j)*S_j admits unique tilted poles. Cauchy--Schwarz for Z=exp(theta1 E)q0(E) (Exp rate r) proves theta2<2theta1; the key renewal theorem yields positive c1,c2, and weighted integrability makes S3=o(S2). This yields reversed late tails and the correct strict extremes via Jensen. Independent numerical quadrature at three (d,D,r) triples verifies strict pole order; no finite computation is used as the large-t proof.

final_claim: For three identical independent Brownian searchers at d>0 with diffusion D>0, reset per-label rate r>0 independently versus one shared Poisson clock of rate r, P(T_(2)^G<=t)>P(T_(2)^I<=t) for 0<t<d^2/(6D), but the strict inequality is reversed eventually; the survival tails are 3c2 exp(-theta2 t) and 3c1^2 exp(-2theta1 t) with 0<theta1<theta2<min(r,2theta1). Extreme arrival ranks have strict all-time comparisons.
